Committee: Agriculture and Forestry
Sponsor: Allen
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/08/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 262 as introduced would provide that the current annual license tax and registration fees for trucks and truck-tractors owned and used by any person for transporting forest products are also applicable to trucks and truck-tractors owned and used by any person for transporting forestry harvesting and management equipment.
This bill could reduce receipts to the Public Road and Bridge Fund, the several counties, and the several municipalities by an undetermined amount dependent on the number of additional forestry truck license plates issued for such trucks and truck-tractors. For each additional forestry license plate issued using the reduced rates under the provisions of this bill, the annual license tax and registration fee would be decreased by a minimum of $260 to a maximum of $455 per license plate, dependent upon the weight of the truck or truck tractor.
Danny Crawford, Chair
Agriculture and Forestry
